content.short: LatAm crypto/fiat wallet and card app.
content.description: Lemon, founded in 2019, is a Latin American crypto and fiat wallet that helps millions of users in Argentina, Peru, and other countries operate in pesos, dollars, and cryptocurrencies from a single app. Users can buy, sell, hold, and spend over 30 cryptocurrencies across many blockchains, convert to USDC digital dollars to hedge against high inflation, and pay everyday expenses with a crypto-linked card that earns Bitcoin cashback. Lemon supports networks including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, and ZKsync, letting users move assets and stablecoins across chains while keeping a familiar banking-style experience. By bridging traditional money and Web3, Lemon has become a leading on-ramp to digital dollars and crypto for everyday Latin Americans.
content.meta: Lemon is a LatAm crypto and fiat wallet with digital dollars and a cashback card. Discover Lemon and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
